verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: the headline is shrunk to a tiny box, 'Your personal' and MUSINA.FR are gone, a stray purple bar and a yellow bar float with no purpose, and the photo is pushed off to one side. B keeps the original composition and all its elements, but it is just the portrait shrunk into the middle of a square, with large empty white areas on both sides; 'Your personal' and MUSINA.FR are too small to read, and nothing was rearranged for the new shape.
